test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_registered_paper_books.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/kernel/registered_paper_books.py tests/test_registered_paper_books.py

implemented: Append-only allocation plans bind the exact frozen eligible-strategy list and evidence ID to unique account IDs and per-book INR capital.
Allocation plans are content-addressed, registered before their effective time, budget-capped, and change-linked to the preceding plan hash and change ID.
Separate persistent PaperAccount journals are opened per strategy with the frozen capital amount; plan creation fails if the allocation omits or adds a strategy outside the frozen manifest.
The registry-scoped order method rejects account mismatches and cash transfers are disabled.
blockers: Registry is not connected to the formal strategy eligibility registry or used by every forward-session order path.
Registration and change evidence IDs are not authenticated by an approved owner-identity service.
Safe account closure and released-capital reconciliation are not implemented, so capital recycling is deliberately blocked.
